title: delphinium occidentale subsp. cucullatum
intro: Delphinium occidentale subsp. cucullatum, commonly known as Western Larkspur, is a flowering plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Western Larkspur are attributed to its ability to exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Western Larkspur include delphinine, a diterpenoid alkaloid that is responsible for its pharmacological activity, as well as other alkaloids and glycosides that contribute to its medicinal properties.
